item.text: I’ll move the overdue query and screen to a post-v1 milestone. First-version acceptance will cover finding books, lending, returns, and restart persistence. I’ll also update the dependencies and review the revised plan.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "codex exec --sandbox read-only --ephemeral --skip-git-repo-check --output-schema '/private/tmp/cc-cpm-w4-t536/onboarding-eval-dzJQNH/home/.agents/skills/story/setup-review-schema.json' - <<'STORYBLOQ_PLAN'
Review id: R3
Independently review this complete revised Storybloq setup plan for coverage, fidelity, dependencies, usability, persistence, privacy and acceptance evidence. Return verdict/findings JSON only. Do not write files, execute setup, or spawn reviewers. Review is required because owner changed scope; previous review R2 requested privacy clarification, now incorporated below.
Source facts: README describes school book room and claims list/add/search/lending/returns done, overdue/persistence pending. Actual src/books.js only in-memory listBooks/addBook with required title and numeric ids; src/server.js only GET/POST /books; test/books.test.js node:test add/list test. package.json npm ESM JavaScript no dependencies, npm test=node --test, npm start=node src/server.js; port defaults 3000. No git/governance files. No install/test/build/server executed during setup. Owner confirms search/lending not done and says plan them. Owner: one teacher uses app; pupils do not. Keep technology, delegate other choices. LATEST OWNER CHANGE: defer overdue list until after first version. V1 now find book, lend to pupil, record return, no loss on restart. Overdue is explicitly deferred, neither v1 UI nor v1 acceptance includes it.
Assumptions: one local teacher workstation, localhost-bound Node server serving plain HTML/CSS/JS, local file snapshots using Node fs; no public hosting/auth/pupil accounts, notifications/fines/reservations. Catalogue record is one physical copy; duplicates allowed. Lending continues to record explicit teacher-entered YYYY-MM-DD due date, supporting the later overdue view. Later overdue = active date before server-local today (today excluded). Minimum pupil display label, not logged, removed on return. Data private/ignored by git. Backups documented; hardware destruction excluded from restart guarantee.
Milestones after default p0 Setup: p1 Reliable catalogue; p2 Lending workflow; p3 Teacher workspace and v1 acceptance; p4 Post-v1 overdue list. Eight tickets A-H; labels provisional, IDs created only on approval. E moves to p4 and gains deferred overdue UI responsibility removed from F. Deferred E must not be selected before v1 acceptance; record explicit deferral and operational selection rule, not a fake technical dependency on H. E technical dependencies D,F. F now depends C,D only; G/H no overdue acceptance. Existing completion A only.
Descriptions use Outcome/Scope/Acceptance/Behaviour/Verification/Prerequisites/Assumptions; all concrete, exclusions explicit.
A p1 baseline complete: Outcome capture actual list/add. Scope in-memory GET/POST, ids; Excludes search/lending/persistence. Acceptance source verified only; title required/default author empty. Behaviour existing implementation, no runtime guarantees. Verification files cited above and unexecuted test. Prerequisites none. Assumptions none.
B p1 durable storage: Outcome data survives restart (owner). Scope private versioned local snapshots, stable ids, serialized atomic writes, file+directory sync, single-process writer exclusion/recovery, durable idempotency records, backup instructions. Excludes remote DB/hardware loss. Acceptance acknowledge after durability boundary; pre-replacement failure leaves prior state; post-replacement uncertain outcome pauses writes and reconciles disk; no universal rollback claim. Stable mutation tokens replay safe identifier/status results, never pupil labels or original request payloads; retain tokens for app lifetime in v1. Current snapshot and replay records consistent. Corrupt existing file preserved and fail closed; clean first start empty; previous acknowledged data survives interrupted writes. Behaviour explicit uncertain/retry guidance, no silent resets/log leaks; private files, fail closed ambiguous lock owner, recover proven-dead same-host writer lock. Verification temp directories, injected write/rename/sync failures, forced termination around replace/sync/ack, simultaneous startups, abandoned lock restart, concurrent writes and no duplicate retries; test absence of pupil labels in replay data. Prerequisites none. Assumptions local filesystem atomic replace/sync semantics. Historical backups may retain prior labels; document separate finite owner-operated retention/deletion procedure, no promise return erases historical backups.
C p1 search/safe catalogue: Outcome teacher finds books (owner). Scope case-insensitive title/author substring GET query, empty lists all, add validation and bounded body, HTTP errors, mutation token validation/adapter. Excludes lending/UI. Acceptance matches/no matches, invalid/oversized JSON never crashes, stable IDs, storage/uncertain error explicit, retry add no duplicate. Behaviour no traces or private data leaks; reads consistent with reconciled state. Verification HTTP search/error/storage/retry tests. Prerequisites B. Assumptions duplicate copies allowed.
D p2 lending/returns: Outcome teacher lends and returns (owner). Scope persisted pupil label+due date, one active loan per copy, book/loan transaction, idempotent APIs, availability. Excludes overdue query/display (deferred E), accounts/fines/reminders. Acceptance double lend rejected including race, unknown IDs rejected, date/pupil validation, return makes available, repeat return harmless; remove pupil label from current loan/application-managed state on return; replay data label-free. Behaviour conflicts/failures/uncertainty explicit, recover before assuming outcome. Verification state-machine/race/HTTP/restart/retry tests, ensure returned pupil label absent from current managed state including replay results. Prerequisites B,C. Assumptions due date remains collected for later overdue.
F p3 teacher workspace: Outcome first-version browser find/lend/return and persistence journey (owner). Scope vanilla accessible same-server UI, local-only bind, catalogue/search/add, lending with date, availability, return, robust states, escaped content, operation tokens persisted for reload recovery; recovery storage contains token/action/resource IDs only, not pupil label/form payload; preserve unsent form input in memory only and clear on resolved operation; uncertain outcome reconciles by token without retaining pupil data. Operational/privacy README correcting current completion claims; root GET 200 then enable VERIFY. Excludes overdue query/view/counters (E after v1), public hosting/auth/pupil login. Acceptance find/lend/return in browser, ack only after durable response, reload/retry no duplicates, keyboard/labels/focus, no pupil in persistent browser recovery state. Behaviour loading/empty/error/success/uncertain guidance, input retained in memory on request failure until resolved/cancelled, duplicate submission prevention. Verification HTTP/static tests, manual keyboard and end-to-end synthetic workflow with restart/failures and browser recovery cleanup. Prerequisites C,D; no E dependency. Assumptions local teacher workstation.
G p3 Checkpoint: review first-version book-room workflow. Criteria demonstrate find/lend/return/date capture, empty/failure/recovery, restart retention with synthetic data. No overdue demonstration. Artifact running v1 browser workflow. Depends F. H alone waits on G.
H p3 Checkpoint: accept first version. Criteria owner accepts find/lend/return/restart persistence, local-only boundary, backup guidance and no tracked pupil data. Overdue explicitly deferred, not a blocker. Artifact app, walkthrough, updated README. Depends G. G/H ordinary checkpoint tickets, human approval not technically enforced.
E p4 deferred overdue list: Outcome teacher sees overdue after v1 (owner latest). Scope overdue API plus accessible browser view with title/pupil/due date, active loans before local today, tests and documentation. Excludes reminders/fines. Acceptance yesterday appears, today excluded, returned excluded; teacher sees list and useful empty state. Behaviour loading/error/retry, keyboard/labels, safe rendering, injectable clock. Verification fixed-clock boundary/returned-loan API tests and synthetic browser demonstration. Prerequisites D,F because extends loan model and teacher workspace. Assumptions documented server-local day. Explicit operational deferral until H accepted; no artificial blockedBy H, no E dependency anywhere in v1.
Coverage: find=C,F; lend/return=D,F; restart=B,D,F; teacher-only=F; existing=A; keep stack=all; overdue=E explicit post-v1 deferral per latest instruction. No unresolved owner decisions; assumptions explicit. B ready first. Deferred work must be identified as such in ledger/phase descriptions, initial handover/setup note and recommended-work selection rules in AGENTS.md; do not auto-start autonomous mode.
Quality level Full pipeline (business rules). WRITE_TESTS and TEST enabled with established npm test and test/books.test.js; BUILD disabled no build step. VERIFY disabled pending F root HTTP200, proposed npm start/http://localhost:3000 then enable. No execution during setup.
Approval covers Shelfmate npm/JavaScript .story, p0 plus four milestones, 8 tickets (1 source-complete, 5 implementation including deferred E, 2 checkpoints), dependencies, AGENTS.md purpose/scope/stack/assumptions/testing/deferral, RULES.md domain/privacy/durability/TDD, REVIEW.md verbatim installed template; git init and ignores .story/snapshots/, .story/sessions/, .story/status.json, data/, node_modules/. Snapshot, initial handover/setup note record coverage/source facts/decisions/quality/review/deferred work/checkpoint limitations. No application implementation, no existing file overwrite, no GitHub import. Setup package still needs explicit approval before creation.
STORYBLOQ_PLAN"

item.text:
**Overdue is now deferred until after v1.** First-version acceptance covers finding books, lending, returns, and persistence across restarts. Due dates remain part of lending, ready for the later overdue feature.

The revised ticket inventory is:

| Milestone | Ticket | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|
| Reliable catalogue | A: Existing list/add API — source-verified complete | — |
| | B: Durable storage and restart recovery | — |
| | C: Search and validated catalogue API | B |
| Lending workflow | D: Lending, returns, and availability | B, C |
| Teacher workspace and v1 acceptance | F: Accessible browser workflow | C, D |
| | G: Checkpoint: review v1 workflow | F |
| | H: Checkpoint: accept v1 | G |
| **Post-v1** | **E: Overdue API and browser view** | D, F |

E will be explicitly deferred until v1 is accepted. It blocks no first-version work. Checkpoints remain ordinary tickets; owner approval is not technically enforced.

The review also checked the clarified storage-recovery and pupil-data retention requirements. No unresolved findings remain.

Reviewer probe: `command -v codex` printed /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-amirshayegh-Developer-CPM/8ce023cb-01f1-4d40-8a3f-cbd10ae934cb/scratchpad/a6bin/codex
Independent review: approve, invocation R3

Approval covers **Shelfmate, npm/JavaScript**, the default Setup phase plus these four milestones, eight tickets, dependencies, snapshot, initial handover, and setup note. It also covers new `AGENTS.md`, `RULES.md`, the standard `REVIEW.md`, Git initialization, and ignores for Storybloq runtime state, `data/`, and `node_modules/`.

Quality level: Full pipeline, for lending rules and persistent state.

- `WRITE_TESTS` and `TEST`: enabled with established `npm test`.
- `BUILD`: disabled; no build step.
- `VERIFY`: disabled pending the browser route; proposed `npm start` with readiness at `http://localhost:3000`.

Local operation, one physical copy per record, and teacher-entered due dates remain labelled assumptions. Storage is the first ready implementation ticket.

Nothing has been written. The [story setup flow](/private/tmp/cc-cpm-w4-t536/onboarding-eval-dzJQNH/home/.agents/skills/story/setup-flow.md) requires approval of the revised package: “One approval of the setup package authorises all of it.”

Approve setup
Adjust the plan
Inspect details
